hero.title: Carlos Baeza Negroni
hero.subtitle: Senior Consulting Engineer Specialized in Blockchain & Smart Contracts
hero.description: Software engineer specialized in Solidity, DeFi, and the entire Ethereum ecosystem and its virtual machine (EVM). His track record includes the design and implementation of complex architectures such as DAOs, NFT collections, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, stablecoin issuance, cross-border payment systems, and advanced staking and tokenomics mechanisms. He stands out for his ability to deploy and manage Layer 1 and Layer 2 (L1/L2) networks, designing everything from private permissioned environments for closed consortia to public networks based on mining consensus. Furthermore, he complements his technical profile with solid experience in large-scale news media platforms and a strong commitment to computer science lecturing.
